diagnosis.observation: C1 again wrote exact frames 1 through 97 and exited immediately after the first cut with no budget breach, but its frame 97 bytes and visible state differ from v0.1 frame 97.
diagnosis.cause: C1 applied the selected marker camera before bpy.ops.render and thereby changed the rendered frame, but then re-read mutable scene.camera after the render operator returned. Blender restored or reevaluated that state, so the post-render assertion rejected an operation that had already used the explicitly applied route.

authorizedChanges.renderer: Capture and assert marker and scene.camera immediately before bpy.ops.render. Record those captured values as marker/camera in the frame row. After render, validate only the immutable PNG path/header/hash/size; scene.camera after the operator may be recorded descriptively but is not an acceptance predicate.
authorizedChanges.runnerAndNodeAuditor: Bind C2 plus both immutable v0.1 and v0.2 trees, move to fresh v0.3, and continue to require exact marker/camera values from the pre-render application record plus independent source-marker derivation and cut-pixel differences.
authorizedChanges.freshExecution: Render all 288 frames from source again. Reuse of v0.1 or v0.2 PNGs is forbidden.
